ITEM 1 | Whole spinach-like leaves, dark green, flat and glossy with slight sheen, scattered across the upper and right side of the plate, leaves about 5-8 cm long, mostly intact with some folded edges | 25
ITEM 2 | Thin cucumber-like rounds and half-moons, pale green with darker green skin edges, smooth and moist-looking, about 1-2 cm wide, arranged in a loose cluster in the center | 30
ITEM 3 | Avocado-like wedges and slices, bright green flesh with a slightly darker outer edge, soft and creamy-looking, pieces about 4-6 cm long and 1-2 cm thick, lying on and among the greens on the left and center | 35
ITEM 4 | Dark brown to reddish-purple whole wrinkled pieces, glossy and slightly shriveled skin, roughly 1.5-2.5 cm in diameter, clustered in the center-left of the plate, some coated with a thin sheen | 30
ITEM 5 | Small pale yellowish-green residue and light smear at the left rim of the plate, thin and sparse, possibly a liquid film, no clear piece shape | 3
